# RustUse

Composable sets of primitive Rust utility crates for fellow crustaceans.

## Primary links

- Primary site: https://rustuse.org/
- Onboarding docs: https://rustuse.org/onboarding/
- Set docs overview: https://rustuse.org/sets/
- Crate docs overview: https://rustuse.org/crates/
- Contributing: https://rustuse.org/contributing/
- GitHub organization: https://github.com/RustUse

## Workspace Rustdocs

Workspace Rustdocs follow these patterns:

- https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/{set}/
- https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/{set}/{crate_module}/index.html

Example:

- https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-math/
- https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-math/use_combinatorics/index.html
